Chokepoint resilience profiles

Source: R/cp_resilience.R
cp_resilience.Rd

Return the per-chokepoint resilience profile for the eight maritime chokepoints: importance and systemic-risk measures, network centrality, route redundancy, recent disruption counts, and composite resilience and vulnerability indices. See chokepoint_resilience for the full column dictionary and how the composite indices are built.

Usage

cp_resilience(
  sort_by = c("vulnerability_index", "resilience_index", "location")
)

Arguments

sort_by

Ordering of the returned rows: "vulnerability_index" (default, most vulnerable first), "resilience_index" (most resilient first), or "location" (alphabetical).

Value

A data frame, one row per chokepoint: the bundled chokepoint_resilience table in the requested order.

See also

cp_map to map it, cp_data for the underlying incidents.

Examples

cp_resilience()
